top_categories.workout_context: 88ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At La Resistance, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of La Resistance. Train it until it feels boring.
7,100ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
La Resistance's French Alps, Alpine gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 81 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic La Resistance's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
At mile 60 of 81, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
7,100ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 81 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 81 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Low-cadence force work for 7,100ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At La Resistance, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for La Resistance’s 81 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at La Resistance. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at La Resistance requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on french alpine gravel to build confidence. Expect: french alps, alpine gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and G Spot to prepare you for 81 miles of french alpine gravel in Talloires, France.
